name: Rayyan
tagline: Rayyan ranks and filters search results during a systematic review, learning from the papers a reviewer includes or excludes to prioritize the ones left to screen. Clinical researchers and academic teams use it to get through thousands of abstracts for a meta-analysis without missing the handful that actually matter.
